summary: Voice v2 relay: transcriptFinal accepts noSpeech=true with an empty text to close a turn whose window held no speech; the turn is marked interrupted, can never execute, releases no held tool call and the next turn is admitted instead of waiting forever on the transcription boundary.
reason: S24 18/10 12:35: a VAD blip after a clarification question opened a turn, the on-device recognizer returned NO_SPEECH_DETECTED and the app cut the whole live session (voice_error_exchange_cut:local_asr_failed); the relay had no way to close a turn without text.
rollback: Revert this commit; a silent window would again end the live session.

tests.name: voice turn protocol
tests.evidence: node scripts/test-voice-turn-protocol.cjs: 25 passed, 0 failed, including the two no-speech cases; node scripts/test-warm-v2-ownership.cjs ok.

capabilities.reason: Voice transport protocol only; no capability route changes.

architecture.reason: Same relay owner and same control; one optional field.

limitations: The false voice-activity start itself (noise or echo interrupting Samantha's answer) is not addressed here; this change only stops it from ending the session.
